player_prompt.intro:
I ni jɛgɛ {player_id} ({role}) kɔnɔ {num_rounds}-ronde Matching Pennies jɛ. 
- Ronde kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, sɔrɔ [heads] walima [tails] (walima [h], [t]).
- Ni a bɛnna a ka jɛgɛfɛnw bɛɛ, Jɛgɛ 0 ka ronde bɛɛ; o si tɛ a ye, Jɛgɛ 1 ka ronde bɛɛ.
Kɛlɛ a ka jɛgɛfɛnw kɔnɔ fɔrmɛ '[heads]' walima '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fɔrɛmɛli maasida; ka bɛɛ o kɔ '[heads]' waati '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Jɛgɛ 0 sɔrɔ {choice0}; Jɛgɛ 1 sɔrɔ {choice1}. Match -> Jɛgɛ 0 ka ronde bɛɛ
message.round_mismatch: Jɛgɛ 0 sɔrɔ {choice0}; Jɛgɛ 1 sɔrɔ {choice1}. Mismatch -> Jɛgɛ 1 ka ronde bɛɛ.
